item.title: Morning Weather for Monday, August 24
item.description: Good morning! Here is your weather report for Monday, August 24. It's Monday, the start of a brand new week. In Shanghai today, expect it to be a little bit rainy. Temperatures will go up to 32 degrees, with a low of 27. There is a 33 percent chance of rain. It's going to be hot. Drink lots of water and wear a hat! A good day for a warm drink and a story. And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be rumbling with thunderstorms, with a high of 31 degrees. Something to think about: what is your favourite kind of weather, and why? And that's the weather. Have a brilliant day!
